memory_candidates.content: In jq, when subtracting a lookup array from a select() via a preceding pipe, e.g. `$deferred | index(.field)`, the `.` inside the piped expression's argument rebinds to the pipe's LHS output ($deferred, an array) rather than to the original filter input. This raises 'Cannot index array with string "<field>"'. Fix by binding the original item to a variable first: `. as $item | ($deferred | index($item.field))`. Always test jq filters with this pattern (pipe into a variable, then call a function taking a `.`-relative argument) against a representative fixture before trusting them.
